items.title: Josh Downs: Back to full participation Thursday
items.text:
Downs (rest/hamstring) upgraded to full participation at Thursday's practice.

items.title: Deebo Samuel: Avoids injured reserve
items.text:
Head coach Kyle Shanahan said Thursday that the 49ers will "hold off" on placing Samuel (hamstring) on IR due to the team's bye in Week 8, Vic Tafur of the Athletic reports.

        Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

items.title: Mike Evans: Won't practice Thursday
items.text:
Head coach Kyle Shanahan said Evans won't practice Thursday due to rib and Achilles injuries, Cam Inman of The San Jose Mercury News reports.

items.title: Kenyon Sadiq: Limited again Thursday

items.title: Caleb Williams: Non-committal on Week 6 status
items.text:
Williams (hamstring) said Thursday that he doesn't know if he'll play this weekend against Atlanta because he still has medical protocols to complete, Sean Hammond of the Chicago Tribune reports.
